honest_verdict.summary: Stage S11.0 establishes a leak-free, license-verified, source-disjoint open-world evaluation harness and five honest baselines across Balanced COPA, SQuAD 2.0, and LongMemEval. Existing Mirror organs, staged rules/blueprints, pure BM25 retrieval, and simple symbolic heuristics expose severe open-world reasoning, causal transfer, abstention, and multi-session belief-update gaps — motivating Stage S11.1.
